types.note: FIBO's agreement/contract kind taxonomy (written/verbal, uni/bi/multilateral, master, transferable and its negations, collateral) collapses to one type: the kind distinctions are classification, not extraction signal in contract text.
Sourced from FND/AgentsAndPeople/People.rdf, the one file Contracts.rdf imports for party concepts; FIBO's own class, FIBO's own definition.

The residual provision bucket: ContractualElement itself plus the subclasses with no more specific type in this pack (conditions precedent, non-binding terms, use-of-proceeds and milestone provisions). Specific provision types below win over this bucket wherever they apply.
Obligations and covenants: what a party promises to do or refrain from doing.
Defined terms: the clause that fixes what a capitalized term means in this contract.
EarlyTerminationProvision flattens in: an early-termination right is a termination provision whose date relation (HasEarlyTerminationDate) keeps the distinction that matters.
Extension and renewal options: the terms under which the contract's term can be lengthened.
Confidentiality and disclosure duties: what a party must reveal, or must not reveal.
Notice mechanics: that notice is required, how, where, and with what lead time.

FIBO's seven-class netting subtree — derivatives-documentation vocabulary (bilateral/multilateral, close-out, novation, payment, settlement) — collapses to the one distinction a flat contract can carry.
FIBO's definition is carried verbatim; in contract text the type is the warranty clause — a party's assurance about the goods, services, or itself, typically with a duration or remedy.
Representations: statements of fact a party makes in or for the contract, on which the counterparty relies.
FIBO references the OMG Commons Organization class but defines no organization class in the imported files; this definition is authored for the flat contract and recorded as authored.
Range class of FIBO's hasGoverningJurisdiction, grounded in OMG Commons RegulatoryAgencies; FIBO states no definition in the imported files, so this one is authored and recorded as authored.
Range class of FIBO's date properties, grounded in OMG Commons DatesAndTimes; FIBO states no definition in the imported files, so this one is authored and recorded as authored.
isBeneficiaryOf states the same link from the beneficiary's side; the two fold into one directed relation.
FIBO's three declared subproperties for specific element kinds fold into the parent relation; the element's type carries the distinction.
